column2: Human rights & detention geography: political prison camps (kwanliso), prisons (kyohwaso), detention/holding centres, labour training camps, execution and burial sites, repatriation points. Must include: NKDB Visual Atlas (visualatlas.org, has a POST /en/api/posts/pool JSON API, figure out all its endpoints, record counts, fields, and whether case data has coordinates), NKDB NKPD (nkpd.org), NKDB Larchiveum, HRNK satellite camp reports (each camp report has imagery dates), Korea Future (penal facility database), TJWG mapping project (killing/burial sites, 'Mapping the Fate of the Dead'), Beyond Parallel camp imagery, Curtis Melvin's North Korea Uncovered KML, Wikipedia/Wikidata coordinates, UN COI annexes, Amnesty camp imagery, any Korean (북한 정치범수용소 위치, 교화소, 집결소) or Japanese (北朝鮮 政治犯収容所 位置) sources.

People, regions and living conditions: admin boundaries (provinces, cities, counties; HDX/OCHA, geoBoundaries, GADM, justinelliotmeyers shapefile), the 2008 DPRK census (UNFPA) by county/city with age/sex, the planned/actual 2018-2019 census, UN WPP, WorldPop and other gridded population, VIIRS / Black Marble night lights (electricity as a proxy), food security (WFP, FAO GIEWS), health (WHO, UNICEF MICS 2017), and South Korean government NK statistics: Statistics Korea KOSIS North Korea statistics portal (북한통계), Ministry of Unification North Korea Information Portal (nkinfo.unikorea.go.kr: it has county-level 'regional information' pages), Bank of Korea NK GDP estimates, Korea Rural Economic Institute. Japanese sources too. We want county-level choropleths: population, density, night lights, etc.

Military, nuclear and missile intel beyond what we have: CSIS Beyond Parallel undeclared missile operating bases (Sino-ri, Sakkanmol, Yusang-ni, Hoejung-ni, Yeongjeo-dong etc. with coordinates), NTI facility database, James Martin CNS datasets (missile test DB updates, nuclear facility DB), 38 North imagery reports (Yongbyon, Sinpo, Sohae, Punggye-ri status over time), IISS, SIPRI, Japan Ministry of Defense missile launch announcements (防衛省 北朝鮮 弾道ミサイル 発射, they publish each launch with times and impact zones), South Korea JCS (합참) launch announcements, Korean/Japanese wiki lists of launches, airbases, naval bases, artillery positions along the DMZ, KPA unit locations (any OSINT KML), Russia-DPRK arms transfer tracking (shipments, rail), North Korean troop deployment data, GitHub OSINT datasets. Also check whether nagix/nk-missile-tests and the CNS database are up to date versus Japan MOD's list of 2025-2026 launches.

Economy, trade, sanctions and infrastructure: market (jangmadang) locations (38 North/Beyond Parallel 2018 study of ~436 markets, Curtis Melvin), market prices over time (Daily NK rice/corn/exchange rate tables, Asia Press/Rimjin-gang prices, NK News/NK Pro), trade data (China customs via UN Comtrade, KOTRA annual NK trade report, Trade Map), UN Panel of Experts reports (ship lists, ship-to-ship transfers, IMO numbers; panel ended 2024, and successor Multilateral Sanctions Monitoring Team MSMT reports 2025-26), sanctions lists (UN consolidated list XML, OFAC SDN DPRK entries, EU, UK, Japan, ROK), ship tracking of sanctioned vessels, crypto theft attribution datasets (Lazarus wallets from FBI/Chainalysis/Elliptic, public lists on GitHub), OSM infrastructure (rail, power plants, mines, ports), mining sites, special economic zones, factories, the 20x10 regional development factories (지방발전 20×10). Korean and Japanese sources included.

Korean- and Japanese-language sources that English-speaking OSINT ignores, any topic about North Korea: Ministry of Unification portals (통일부 북한정보포털, 북한인권기록센터 reports, 북한이탈주민 statistics by year/age/gender/origin province), KINU white papers (통일연구원 북한인권백서) and their tables, NK defectors' origin provinces stats, Rimjin-gang/Asia Press (アジアプレス) data, Japanese abductee issue data (拉致被害者, 特定失踪者 list with locations and dates from 特定失踪者問題調査会), Chongryon/repatriation (帰国事業) data, NHK/Japanese MOD datasets, Korean National Assembly reports, KBS/YTN NK databases, 북한 지명 (NK place-name) gazetteers with coordinates (e.g. 국토지리정보원 북한 지명), Korean open data portals (data.go.kr datasets about North Korea, e.g. 북한 행정구역, 북한 지도), 국립중앙도서관 북한자료센터, and Korean-language GitHub projects. Find datasets nobody has mapped in English.
